messages:
Nia G.: Heads-up: we're shipping a billing terms refactor on July 10. Main items: consolidate invoice line items, introduce tiered soft rate limits, and shorten trial credit validity to 90 days. Internal guide + CSV examples: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/refactor :loudspeaker:
Billing Bot: New doc posted: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/refactor (includes CSV schema and sample rows)
Samir P.: Will the soft limits be plan-dependent? need to know for autoscaling thresholds.
Nia G.: Yes, limits scale by plan. Self-serve customers get lower soft thresholds; reserved pools keep their guarantees. Soft limits trigger throttling first, 429s only after sustained over-threshold conditions (configurable hold window).
DevEx: can we add `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Policy` and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining` headers so SDKs can adapt?
Nia G.: Good suggestion. Rollout will include headers and a recommended retry pattern in the SDK docs.
Liam H.: How are overage charges displayed? single invoice or separate invoice?
Nia G.: Overage appears as a line item on the same monthly invoice; credits are applied after calculating totals. CSV shows examples.
Support Bot: Action item: update KB articles and canned replies about credit expirations and the 7-day grace window for overages.
Samir P.: Are we grandfathering currently issued trial credits?
Nia G.: Yes  any credits issued before the refactor keep the 180-day expiry. New credits after July 10 will expire in 90 days.
DevEx: ETA for SDK changes? we need headers surfaced and a small code example.
Nia G.: Aim to have SDK PRs by July 3. AMA scheduled July 5 09:00 PT in #all-hands for Q&A. Please review the doc and add questions there.
Support Bot: Reminder: rollout date July 10.
